app.name: CV Builder
app.tagline: Write one page, watch it fill, export it to Word. Nothing you type leaves this browser.

data.importFailed: That file is not a CV Builder document.
data.resetConfirm: Delete this CV and start from an empty one?

setup.title: Setup
setup.directionHint: Direction of the CV itself, not of this interface.
setup.fileNameHint: The .docx extension is added on download.

section.heading: Section heading
section.hidden: This whole section is left out of the document.

line.leadHint: Set in bold. The few words a recruiter reads before deciding to read the rest.
line.languagesHint: One line, on its own row at the foot of the document.
line.footnoteHint: Optional. The last line of the document, set by the style.

offer.title: Job offer
offer.hint: Read in this browser against a built-in vocabulary. No model, no network.
offer.pasteFailed: Your browser would not hand over the clipboard. Paste into the box instead.
offer.none: Nothing recognisable in this ad yet.
offer.allCovered: This CV answers everything the ad names.

ats.title: ATS compatibility
ats.note: Checks parser risks and the generated Word file. This cannot guarantee a decision by a specific hiring system.
ats.local: Generated and read locally. Nothing is uploaded.
ats.failed: The generated document could not be checked.
ats.docxPending: Run the DOCX check to see what a text parser can read.

finding.singleColumn: The exported document follows one reading column.
finding.bodyContacts: Contact details are in the document body, not a Word header.
finding.nameOwnLine: The name sits on its own line, which parsers treat as the candidate.
finding.nameSharedLine: The name shares a line with contact details; some parsers miss the email.
finding.headingBlank_one: {{count}} visible section has no heading, so later content may be misfiled.
finding.headingBlank_other: {{count}} visible sections have no heading, so later content may be misfiled.
finding.decorativeChars: These marks may be stripped or read as boxes: {{marks}}.
finding.linkedinFound: A LinkedIn URL is present for the candidate profile.
finding.linkedinMissing: Add a LinkedIn URL; many ATS store it as its own field.
finding.phoneUnparseable: The phone field does not contain enough digits to parse as a number.
finding.locationFound: A location is visible for geographic matching.
finding.locationMissing: Add and show a location when the ATS filters by city or country.
finding.fileNameUnsafe: The download name is empty or contains characters some ATS reject on upload.
finding.nameMissing: Add a full name so the ATS can create the candidate record.
finding.emailMissing: Add and show a valid email address.
finding.phoneMissing: Add and show a phone number when the application expects one.
finding.experienceFound: At least one role has a title and company.
finding.experienceMissing: Add a visible role with both a title and company.
finding.educationFound: Education content is available to the parser.
finding.educationMissing: No visible education entry can be parsed.
finding.skillsFound: A visible skills section is present.
finding.skillsMissing: Add a visible skills section with plain-text skill names.
finding.headingsStandard: Visible section headings use familiar ATS wording.
finding.headingsCustom: These headings may not be classified: {{headings}}.
finding.datesReadable: Visible roles and education entries include a four-digit year.
finding.datesUnclear: {{count}} date fields have no four-digit year.
finding.linkTargetsHidden: {{count}} links show a label instead of their full URL; some parsers may miss the destination.
finding.offerMissing: Paste the job ad to check keyword coverage.
finding.offerUnrecognized: The built-in vocabulary found no reliable job terms.
finding.keywordsCovered: Every recognised job term appears in the CV.
finding.keywordsMissing: {{missing}} of {{asked}} recognised job terms are missing.
finding.docxUnreadable: The generated DOCX could not be opened as structured text.
finding.docxReadable: The DOCX opened as {{paragraphs}} readable paragraphs.
finding.docxNameFound: The candidate name survived DOCX extraction.
finding.docxNameMissing: The candidate name disappeared from extracted DOCX text.
finding.docxEmailFound: The visible email survived DOCX extraction.
finding.docxEmailMissing: The visible email disappeared from extracted DOCX text.
finding.docxTablesFound: The DOCX contains tables, which can alter reading order.
finding.docxNoTables: The DOCX contains no layout tables.
finding.docxHeaderFound: The DOCX stores content in a header or footer.
finding.docxBodyOnly: All CV content stays in the main document body.
finding.docxDrawingsFound: The DOCX contains drawings or text boxes, which parsers often skip.
finding.docxNoDrawings: The DOCX contains no drawings or text boxes.
finding.docxNameFirst: The first readable paragraph still starts with the candidate name.
finding.docxNameNotFirst: The first readable paragraph does not start with the candidate name.
finding.docxLinkUrlsHidden: {{count}} hyperlink destinations never appear as visible text.
finding.docxRetentionGood: {{percent}}% of visible fields survived text extraction.
finding.docxRetentionPartial: Only {{percent}}% of visible fields survived text extraction.
finding.docxRetentionPoor: Only {{percent}}% of visible fields survived text extraction.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Start writing and the page appears here.

export.failed: The document could not be built: {{reason}}
